name: Efficiency with a resistive load
description: Efficiency of a converter whose load is made of real resistors that you write down or take from a kit (one resistor, or series and parallel groups, each with its tolerance and its power rating). It is the efficiency measurement with the same editor: the load parameter steps through the resistors, connecting each load by hand or through the relays of a multiplexer, with the converter switched off while the load changes; the power in every resistor is checked against its rating on every reading.

roles.name: instruments
roles.description: Every instrument used: sources, loads, meters, data loggers

roles.name: scope
roles.description: An oscilloscope that takes waveforms during the measurement (optional: the scope settings files of the project say how; see scope_capture)

golden.description: check the result against a golden sample of the project (a good unit of the same kind): name (in the golden/ folder of the project) or run (a run file), and tolerances = {rows: {match: [columns that pair the rows], columns: {column: tolerance}}, curves, min_overlap}

variables.description: Ordered list of parameters; the first one changes first (innermost sweep)

timing.description: settle_s after setting, then 'samples' readings 'interval_s' apart, averaged

scope_capture.description: waveforms during the measurement: instruments (the oscilloscopes, role scope), every (a capture every N steps, 1 = every step) and/or when (conditions on a quantity of the step), and optionally max, channels, bits (8 or 16) and wait_s; the acquisitions are the scope settings files of the project that are on, one after another
